name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Stable raid runtime, native wild-controller combat and the authoritative static arena remain enabled. The visible boundary now uses a server-spawned marker ring through UPalNPCManager::SpawnNPCForServer, the same proven server-to-client spawn path as the raid boss. Native AreaBarrier lock-state sync remains available as a diagnostic module but is no longer loaded because it stayed invisible on clients. PalNetworkTransmitter, direct Lua NetMulticast, BuildObject walls and SkillEffect barriers remain disabled. No client installation required.
